CREATE DATABASE SCOPED CREDENTIAL cred_varun
WITH
    IDENTITY = 'Managed Identity'

CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE source_silver
WITH
(
    LOCATION = ' https://adventurestoragedatalake.blob.core.windows.net/silver',
    CREDENTIAL = cred_varun
)

CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE source_gold
WITH
(
    LOCATION = 'https://adventurestoragedatalake.blob.core.windows.net/gold',
    CREDENTIAL = cred_varun
)

CREATE EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT format_parquet
WITH
(
    FORMAT_TYPE = PARQUET,
    DATA_COMPRESSION = 'org.apache.hadoop.io.compress.SnappyCodec'
)


---------------------------------------------
-------CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE EXTSALES
---------------------------------------------
CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE gold.extsales
WITH
(
    LOCATION = 'extsales',
    DATA_SOURCE = source_gold,
    FILE_FORMAT = format_parquet
)

SELECT * FROM gold.Sales

DROP EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE source_gold;
GO

CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE source_gold
WITH
(
    LOCATION = 'https://adventurestoragedatalake.dfs.core.windows.net/gold',
    CREDENTIAL = cred_varun
);
GO
